lines.en: I can't believe I'm crying in front of you.
You must think I'm so pathetic.
No, no, no, I admire a man who can cry.
Hey, hey, Rach, how's it going?
Oh, my God, this is the worst date ever.
Look, you know what, I'm sorry,
but did you really think that this was going well?
Hey, did you stop by here?
Oh, thank God, Emma, there you are!
What do you mean, there you are?
She just, she loves it when I'm dramatic.
